reading.body:
This record describes a facility tagged as a data center in Spain but may be misclassified, since the name "The Weaver" suggests textile work or hospitality rather than IT infrastructure.

The OpenStreetMap database tags this location near Alicante as a data center, yet the business name carries no indication of computing, hosting, or telecom operations. The tag may reflect a data entry error rather than an actual facility. Research to confirm the site's true function could not be completed due to resource constraints.

This entry illustrates a challenge in mapping AI infrastructure: public databases contain unverified records that conflate genuine data centers with misattributed locations. Without operator information, website, power draw, or construction details, the facility's actual role in compute capacity cannot be determined. The entry records this uncertainty rather than guessing, which is the only honest approach when source material is ambiguous and verification has been exhausted.
